interpretation.result: Changing only the task emulator's temporary GPU backend resolved the observed black home screen for this unchanged APK.
interpretation.likely_cause: SwiftShader shader compilation incompatibility, consistent with Godot issue 109550. This does not establish compatibility on physical devices.

acceptance_limits.control_state: Official Computer Use app selection was approved, but capture failed. Raising the emulator window succeeded; the allowed screenshot retry again returned: window capture timed out: timed out waiting on channel. No native game input followed.
acceptance_limits.remaining_gate: Complete genuine native interaction, ad callback and persistence acceptance, plus phone and tablet runtime capture provenance, through working authorized tooling. These diagnostic images do not satisfy that gate.
